{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check how many missing values in flipper_length_mm per species
df_missing_by_species = df.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].apply(lambda x: x.isnull().sum())
print(df_missing_by_species)

# Also check total count per species to see if the missingness is balanced
print('\nTotal count per species:')
df_count_by_species = df.groupby('species').size()
print(df_count_by_species)"}
